label: Text colour
help: The foreground under test - defaults to the design system text colour.

label: Background
help: The surface the text sits on - defaults to the design system surface.

label: Check
help: One pair, or every combination of the design system palette.

label: Contrast scale
help: WCAG 2.1 ratios with AA/AAA verdicts, or APCA Lc. APCA trades contrast against text size, so it has no size-free pass or fail - the palette just reports each Lc, flagging only pairs below the usable floor.

label: Text size
help: Large text is 18pt, or 14pt bold. It passes at a lower ratio: AA 3:1 and AAA 4.5:1, against 4.5:1 and 7:1 for normal text.

label: Sample text
help: The sentence shown in the sample panel.
